subject: Mosaic Health — Kickstart session: demo, procurement intake & security gate
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Mosaic Health — Kickstart session: demo, procurement intake & security gate

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the time earlier this week. We'd like to get a formal kickoff on the calendar to align the demo, procurement intake, and security gating so your team can evaluate Redwood for the pilot. Proposed objectives for the first session:

- 30–45 min technical demo (AE + SE present)
- 30 min procurement intake: timeline, contact list, required docs (PO, SOW, vendor security)
- Confirm next steps and owners for SOC2 / data residency questions

Availability from our side (PST): Tue 7/20 10:00–12:00, Wed 7/21 14:00–16:00, Thu 7/22 09:00–11:00. Please let me know what works for your procurement and InfoSec leads.

I attached a short onboarding checklist and our security questionnaire (v1) for your intake team to skim before the call. If you prefer, we can split procurement and security follow-ups into a separate 30-minute block after the demo.

Also looping Soojin (SE) and Aditya (Solutions) to cover technical and procurement questions on the call.

Thanks,

--
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet), Mosaic_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mosaic Health — Kickstart session: demo, procurement intake & security gate

Thanks Jonas — helpful framing. Our procurement and InfoSec teams reviewed the attachments briefly. A couple quick notes: 

- Procurement cannot meet before Mon 8/2 due to month-end vendor reviews; they can do the week of 8/2 (prefer Tue/Wed).
- InfoSec (Daniel) would like a short pre-demo list of the data categories you expect customers to send (PII / de-identified / logs) and confirmation of regions for data residency.
- We'll include Sarah Li (procurement lead) and Daniel on the scheduling thread.

I'll be the primary coordinator and can host a joint 60-minute kickoff on Tue 8/3 or Wed 8/4 between 09:00–11:30 PT. Which day works for your team? Once we confirm, I'll send a Calendly/Invite and include our vendor onboarding packet.

Best,
Priya Singh
Director, Vendor Programs
Mosaic Health
priy a.singh@mosaichealth.com | +1 (617) 555-0243

8/3 10:00 PT works for our team. We'll plan for a 60-minute joint kickoff (demo + procurement Q&A) and schedule:

- 30–55 min: Procurement & contracting intake (Jonas + Aditya)

Subject: Re: Mosaic Health — Kickstart session: demo, procurement intake & security gate

Priya / team — quick pre-call note from SE side so we can use the kickoff efficiently: 

1) Data categories: please confirm whether the demo will include any production customer data. If not, a redacted sample (CSV or JSON) is ideal.
2) Deployment preference: if you anticipate Private (VPC/on-prem) as a must, let us know so we can have a short checklist ready (networking, KMS, hardware footprint).
3) SOC2 evidence: we can surface our Type II report and a short controls mapping during the call — if Daniel wants specific controls up-front (e.g., encryption at rest key ids, audit log retention), list them and we'll attach answers.

If helpful, I can prepare a 1-pager for Daniel that maps Mosaic's high-level questions to Redwood artifacts (SOC2 link, data flow diagram, minimum integration points).

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

Thanks all — invite sent for Tue, Aug 3rd at 10:00–11:00 PT. Calendar invite includes: Sarah (procurement), Daniel (InfoSec), myself, and a small engineering contingent.

A couple items we added in the invite notes:
- Please bring a short SOW summary and list of required contract terms (standard SLAs, data handling obligations).
- Procurement asks that vendor systems support SOC2 Type II and a contractual clause for data deletion within 60 days of contract termination.
- InfoSec requested the 1-pager Soojin mentioned and a sample data schema if possible.

I'll upload Mosaic's vendor packet to the shared Drive link included in the invite and will add a security contact email alias (security@mosaichealth.com) to the thread.

See you on 8/3.

Warmly,
Priya
